name: Denna Faraday
source: Lena's mom has always been a hard-working woman. Maybe too preoccupied with making ends meet to be as caring as Lena would've needed, she can be a bit obtuse and disregard her daughter's feelings. That's why they have always had a difficult relationship, to the extent that Lena knew from a very early age she wanted to go to live on her own.
